title: Netflix Casspactor to Cassandra Analytics shadow migration
legacy_state: Casspactor pipeline reads backup information through multiple changing metadata services.
target_state: Cassandra Analytics reads S3 backup source metadata into model-specific Spark DataFrames.

claims.statement: Netflix described testing both legacy-minus-new and new-minus-legacy output sets during shadow validation.
claims.source_section: Journey Towards a Safe Migration — Pillar 1: Validation
claims.qualification: Source-reported output comparison; no independent reproduction or production SQL captured.

limitations: Exact per-job performance measurement and private code unavailable

title: Stripe online migration of subscription data ownership
legacy_state: Subscription model embedded in Customer records with incompatible future evolution.
target_state: Subscriptions migrated to separately stored authoritative table through online phases.

claims.statement: Stripe described dual writing, backfilling, comparing read paths, switching read/write authority and removing the legacy representation.
claims.source_section: A pattern for online migrations; Part 1–4
claims.qualification: Publisher-described process; timing of every internal event and independent performance replication unknown.
